name: @artifisio/mcp

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked free-text search across the public illustration, icon and font registries. Returns rows with slug, kind, license, install command and preview URL; the first few results also come back as inline preview images. Use `color` to rank by brand palette proximity.

query.description: Free text: subject, vibe, style words (e.g. "friendly people fintech")

color.description: Brand hex (#RRGGBB); adds palette proximity to the ranking

tag.description: Comma-separated tags that must all match

previewCount.description: How many results get an inline preview image

tools.name: show
tools.description: Full detail of one set: palette with themeable slots, every illustration or icon with preview URLs per format (or font styles + stylesheet), license, install commands. The cover comes back as an inline image.

kind.description: Registry to look the slug up in; default probes every kind

tools.name: facets
tools.description: Tags, themeable palette slots, background counts, font scripts and weights, icon grids and stroke widths across the registries — use to narrow a search.

tools.name: add
tools.description: Downloads a set into the project (illustrations under ./public/illustrations/<slug>, icons under ./public/icons/<slug>, fonts under ./public/fonts/<slug>), applies brand colors as CSS variables, writes a typed index, pins the version in .artifisiorc.json and regenerates ATTRIBUTION.md. Use `dryRun` to see the plan first.

private.description: Install one of your private sets (requires an API key): illustrations, icons with `kind: "icon"` or fonts with `kind: "font"`

autoColor.description: Brand hexes mapped greedily to the closest themeable slots

format.description: Comma-separated formats: illustrations svg,png,png@2x,png@3x,webp,jpg,pdf | fonts woff2,otf,ttf | all. Icons are always SVG: anything but svg/all is rejected.

bake.description: Bake colors into the SVG instead of CSS variables

dir.description: Output directory relative to the project root

emit.description: Typed index: "ts" or "dts"; or "paths" (icons only): paths.ts with every icon's path data (`iconPaths`, `IconName`, `viewBox`, `fillRule`) for inline rendering

projectDir.description: Project root (stdio only); default the server project dir

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Credit estimate and remaining balance for a generation before running it. 1 credit = US $0.01.

icons.description: "icons" only: the icons of the set, as names (lowercase, digits, dashes) or `{ name, hint }` where `hint` says what to draw

referenceImages.description: How many reference images the run is given (`imageUrls`), each priced as model input; 1 for "icons" drawn into an existing `set`

size.description: "image", "edit" and "icons" only: output size (for "icons", the sheet resolution, default 2K)

prompt.description: "icons" and "font": the brief, refused when blank or longer than 600 characters

background.description: "illustration" only: `transparent` cuts the background out of every image (png with alpha; kept in your own style as png and webp). A flat ground is colour-keyed out for free; any other is cut out at 1 credit an image

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate illustrations in a registry/private style (`useCase: "illustration"` + `style` slug; in a style of your own each image is kept as a published illustration, so `add` installs it), one-off images from a prompt with no style (`"image"`, optional reference images, `aspectRatio`, `size`), edits of input images (`"edit"`, `imageUrls` required), explore a new style from a brief (`"style"`; a flat background colour the brief names, e.g. "on a flat navy background", is kept and drawn on from then on, otherwise the pipeline picks a flat one; optionally `saveAs` to keep it as a private style to generate illustrations in, then `add`), explore logo concepts (`"logo"`: `name` + the brief as `prompt`; `count` concepts, default 3, max 8, each a brand board (symbol, wordmark, lockup, app icon) on a distinct direction, kept as a private logo `id`, with a numbered `contactSheetUrl`), change one (`"logo"` + `logoId` + `concept` + `refine`, the change to make: that board is drawn again with only that change and kept on the logo as a new concept, quoted and charged as one board), or finalize one (`"logo"` + `logoId` + `concept`: mark, wordmark, lockups, favicons and OG image as a brand pack, saved to <project>/public/brand), or generate an icon set (`"icons"`: the style brief as `prompt` plus `icons`, drawn on one sheet, traced to SVG and kept as your private icon set, installable with `add` + `kind: "icon"` + `private: true`, plus `extras`: the icons that filled the rest of the sheet, outside the set (restore one at `manageUrl` to keep it); an icon set takes about three minutes: a call waits up to 45 seconds, then returns `generating` with its id, and a later call with `iconSetId` collects it, free, saving the SVGs under <project>/generations/icons/<id>; with `set` (one of your icon sets) and no `prompt`, the `icons` are drawn in that set's own style beside a few of its icons and written into it, `mode: "add"` (default) for new names or `"redraw"` to replace icons it holds in place, same names and slug; `flagged` names the icons the pipeline's QC flagged, the ones to redraw), or a typeface (`"font"`: the brief as `prompt`, the family name as `name` (never a trademarked font name), `count` DNA candidates, default 4, max 4, each a specimen of one design on its own direction (a garbled specimen is redrawn once, then dropped uncharged, so fewer can come back); then `fontId` + `candidate` builds the whole Latin charset from one into your private font set, installable with `add` + `kind: "font"` + `private: true`; each step takes minutes: a call waits up to 45 seconds, then returns `generating`, and a later call with `fontId` (plus `candidate` for the build) collects it, free, saving the files under <project>/generations/fonts/<id>). A logo finalize is waited on until the pack is ready; calling again for a concept that is already built or building never charges twice, a failed one is reported until you call again with `retry: true`, and `totalCostInCents` is always what building the pack cost. Always quoted first; refused when the estimate exceeds `maxCredits` or the balance. Results come back as URLs and inline images, and are saved under <project>/generations.

prompt.description: What to generate: required, except with `logoId` or `iconSetId` (ignored there) and `fontId` or an icons `set` (refused there); for "logo" and "font", the brief; for "icons", the style brief. An "icons" or "font" brief is at most 600 characters

name.description: "logo": the name the logo spells (required); "icons": the set name (default: the brief); "font": the family name (default "AI Typeface"; with `candidate`, renames it when building; ignored for a candidate already built)

tagline.description: "logo" only: optional tagline, used as context

colors.description: "logo" only: #rrggbb colours the concepts may use

logoId.description: "logo" only: finalize this logo (with `concept`), or refine it (with `concept` + `refine`), instead of exploring

concept.description: "logo" with `logoId`: the concept `index` to build the brand pack from, or to refine

refine.description: "logo" with `logoId` + `concept`: the change to draw that concept again with (e.g. "warmer colours"), kept as a new concept; leave it out to finalize

retry.description: "logo" and "font" finalize: build this concept or candidate again after its last finalize failed

icons.description: "icons" only: the icons of the set, as names (lowercase, digits, dashes) or `{ name, hint }` where `hint` says what to draw

accent.description: "icons" only: #rrggbb accent colour, required for duotone

stroke.description: "icons" only: stroke width on a 24 box (default 2); it steers the drawing, the SVGs are traced filled outlines

iconSetId.description: "icons" only: collect the icon set this id started instead of generating; free

set.description: "icons" only: draw `icons` into this icon set of yours (slug or id) instead of starting a new one; it keeps its own brief and name, so leave out `prompt`, `fill`, `accent`, `stroke` and `name`. It draws with the default icon model, not the one the set was made with, unless `model` says otherwise

mode.description: "icons" with `set`: `add` icons the set does not hold (default), or `redraw` icons it holds, replaced in place unless the drawing drifted from the family (then reported in `rejected`)

fontId.description: "font" only: collect the candidates of this font (free), or with `candidate` build one

candidate.description: "font" with `fontId`: the candidate `index` to build the font from

charset.description: "font" only: the glyphs to draw (default latin-text: caps, lowercase, digits, punctuation)

imageUrls.description: Reference images (URLs or data: URLs); required for "edit"

aspectRatio.description: "image" and "edit" only; nearest the model supports

size.description: "image" and "edit": nearest the model supports; "icons": the sheet resolution (default 2K)

saveAs.description: "style" only: keep the result as a published private style with this name; illustrations generated in it are kept in it

background.description: "illustration" only: `transparent` cuts the background out of every image (png with alpha; kept in your own style as png and webp). A flat ground is colour-keyed out for free; any other is cut out at 1 credit an image

maxCredits.description: Refuse if the estimate exceeds this (defaults to .artifisiorc.json defaults.maxCreditsPerCall)

inlineImages.description: Return the generated images as inline image content (default true)

download.description: Also save the images under <project>/generations, a logo pack under <project>/public/brand (default true)

instructions: Artifisio: free, open-licensed illustration, icon and font registries plus paid generation. Flow: `search` (inline previews) → `show` → `add` to install (CSS-var theming, ATTRIBUTION.md). When nothing fits: `quote` then `generate` (illustrations, images, styles, logos, icon sets, fonts). This server writes into /pkg (override with `projectDir`). Every generation is quoted first and refused when it exceeds `maxCredits` or the balance.
